claim: Open until PR #617's reader slice lands the gateway's call of pos_item_sales in AnalyticsService (ADR 0298 decisions 1 to 7) and flips this row to resolved. Any non-test source under apps, services or packages naming the function, in any spelling of the call, holds it, so a reader that lands without flipping it fails the build. Generated database types and fixtures do not hold it.

Open until the digest's PR, the last of ADR 0298's split, composes the digest for the house's sales holders (decision 9) and flips this row to resolved. The digest is composed in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/digest/ (recommendation-digest.service.ts on main); the reader is readSalesHolderIds in apps/api-gateway/src/notifications/producers/sales-holders.ts. Any non-test file of the digest's directory that names the reader or imports its module holds it.
